newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel quiet, waits for next week.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel quiet, waits for next week.

text.p: Stronger crude prompted sellers of low sulphur straight run to peg prices higher, but there was little buying interest.
Traders said the market was in the low $140s fob NWE but that most activity would probably occur next week when offices are fully staffed.
Russian straight run continues to be offered with an E-4 heard loading today in the Baltic. In the Black Sea an M-100 was already on the water.
E-4 levels in NWE were pegged at formula +$1-2 a tonne. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8980
